meta.name: domain-modeling
meta.description: Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when the user wants to pin down domain terminology or a ubiquitous language, record an architectural decision, or when another skill needs to maintain the domain model.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 梳理并完善项目的领域模型与通用语言
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中明确领域术语或记录架构决策
copy.tagline_en: Refine and document your project's domain model and ubiquitous language
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to clarify domain terminology or record architectural decisions in your project

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会主动帮你梳理项目中的术语，发现矛盾时立刻指出，并帮你把确定的术语写进项目文件。
howto.when: 当你讨论项目术语、记录架构决策，或需要澄清某个概念时触发。

say.text: 帮我确认一下，我们说的“用户”是指顾客还是系统账号？
say.note: Claude 会检查现有术语并帮你明确。

say.text: 记录一个架构决策：为什么选择事件溯源？
say.note: Claude 会判断是否值得记录并创建 ADR 文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude actively helps you clarify project terminology, points out contradictions, and writes resolved terms into project files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you discuss project terms, record architectural decisions, or need to clarify a concept.

say_en.text: Help me confirm: does 'user' mean customer or system account?
say_en.note: Claude checks existing terms and helps clarify.

say_en.text: Record an architectural decision: why choose event sourcing?
say_en.note: Claude judges if it's worth recording and creates an ADR file.
